name: vllm_meta_stack_v1
description: Self-hosted reference stack: official weights `meta-models/Muse-Glimmer-30B` on vLLM with Automatic Prefix Caching. Launch with `bash scripts/launch_vllm.sh` (T4: 80 GB BF16; T3: 24 GB needs QUANTIZATION). Then `BACKEND=local_server LOCAL_SERVER_KIND=vllm`. The agent, prompts, Lean checker and protocol axes are identical to openrouter_scale_v1 so the two tables are comparable. Server-side hit rate comes from Prometheus (`--enable-prompt-tokens-details`).
